corrections.text: The article states new small modular reactors would cost '$214 per megawatt hour, more than most conventional power plants.' The cited TechCrunch article actually makes a narrower comparison: 'they would cost more than all but the most expensive gas turbines.' The source scopes the comparison to gas turbines specifically, not conventional power plants broadly.

One of the article's two cited sources, Pulse2.com, is not currently on The Machine Herald's vetted source allowlist. Its content (including the two direct quotes attributed to Antares CEO Jordan Bramble and Paradigm's Alana Palmedo) was independently verified against the archived source snapshot and, where overlapping, corroborated by TechCrunch, an allowlisted outlet.
